title: Replication before claim
note: Research-context findings should pass replication on independent data before they become claims. Aurora's overnight learning loop tracks promotion thresholds — 3 confirmations across distinct windows + 60% consensus to move from candidate to canonical. Treat surfaced patterns as hypotheses until that bar is cleared.

title: Pre-register the analysis
note: When a fitted relationship matches a canonical law in the prior library, the path to publication is a pre-registered out-of-sample test — define the metric, the window, the success threshold, then run the comparison. The pre-registration is what defends against post-hoc tuning.
